prompt:
Create a finished illustration for a public book-summary library for adult readers. Use a calm, contemporary illustrated-book style: hand-painted gouache, soft matte pigment, restrained pencil details, and a subtle warm ivory paper texture. Use a consistent palette of muted sage and olive green, warm ochre, natural wood brown, and warm ivory, with dark brown or charcoal details. Keep saturation restrained and lighting soft and natural. Give the scene generous breathing room, a clear focal point, and simple, recognizable forms that remain readable on a phone. When people are relevant, depict believable adults with natural proportions, respectful expressions, and ordinary clothing. Use the same medium, palette, texture, and level of detail across the illustration. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, neon colors, cinematic effects, heavy black outlines, childish clipart, ornamental clutter, and a different art style in each panel. No readable text, captions, logos, watermarks, fake book covers, or invented author portraits. Keep all explanations and essential labels outside the generated image.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square hero for Stuff Matters by Mark Miodownik. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its gouache pigment, ivory paper texture, soft light, restrained sage and ochre palette and visual density; do not copy its person, desk, or composition. Create a new balanced square still life on a broad pale concrete rooftop ledge with a softly suggested urban skyline in the distance. One ivory porcelain teacup and saucer are the central focal point, with a simple stainless steel teaspoon on the saucer. Beside it place a short graphite pencil on a folded blank sheet of ivory paper, a small unwrapped piece of dark chocolate, and a clear drinking glass with a little water. Make each material recognizable through restrained painted texture and shape: translucent glass, smooth ceramic, matte concrete, dark chocolate, wood pencil, subtle metallic spoon. This is an imagined arrangement illustrating the book's everyday materials, not a recreation of a photograph or a documented event. No people, no molecular diagrams, no readable marks. Keep all objects comfortably inside the edges, provide breathing room, and make the main objects clear at a 360px display size. Finished square composition, at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.

reference_images.role: Style reference only; inspected before generation
